auditScope: Static Gherkin-to-Java semantic comparison and provenance reconciliation; no runtime reruns.

semanticAudit.mismatch: Creates and lists content but omits scheduling date, public hiding, clock advance, and promotion.
Creates content and checks a row/container; never selects, persists, or publicly renders its cover image.
Creates content without Static status or checks for static navigation and exclusion from the blog stream.
Changes a role dropdown but asserts another user field and generic admin title; no target-role confirmation or access check.
Creates a category only; omits assigned post, count, filtered public route, and exclusion of other-category posts.
Creates a directory; performs none of the requested upload, move, or delete lifecycle.
Opens Groups and checks its title; no non-member setup, denied access, hidden resources, or registration check.
Manually creates an exercise instead of importing a ZIP package; does not verify imported package contents.
Checks generic exercise statistics, not student tracking denial or teacher analytics for the named attempt.
Begins announcement creation but omits body and student banner verification; assertion searches course text for title.
Adds one product and checks cart count; never tries quantity above stock or verifies rejection and unchanged quantity.
Adds an item and opens checkout; never updates/persists the address or checks checkout prefill.
Creates an invalid-date promotion instead of updating existing SUMMER20; generic page/title text substitutes for exact error and unchanged dates.
Uses admin user creation instead of guest storefront registration; no customer-count invariant.
Creates/lists an inventory item instead of changing stock 0→5 and checking storefront badge/cart capability.
Saves an article but does not toggle Featured or verify featured-list transitions.
Checks editor rendering; no publish-up/down changes or visibility-window behavior.
Logs in as author and checks a page, but does not attempt the restricted state change or assert denial.
Inspects article category/listing; never edits or verifies version increment/history.
Asserts a generic alert; does not verify trash, restore, or restored publication status.
Navigates to a closed task and asserts it remains closed; no reopen action or reopened-state assertion.
Types a comment without submitting; assertion permits page/title presence instead of persisted comment stream.
Opens/checks duplicate modal but never completes duplication or verifies target task.
Opens/checks move modal but does not select destination or verify moved task.
Enters subtask text but accepts container presence; does not verify persisted named subtask.
Opens issue and checks summary/title; never monitors/unmonitors or verifies monitor-list isolation.
Checks status and notes-container presence; does not create private note or compare visibility across roles.
Checks priority and relationship-control presence; does not create links or test self/duplicate rejection.
Checks severity/upload input; does not upload/download or reject an empty selection.
Checks category/tag-control presence; does not attach or filter by a tag.
Searches a fixed page and checks unchanged title/nonempty body; does not move page or verify redirect.
Clicks Watch but uses broad page text; no user scoping, watchlist verification, or unwatch.
Checks upload form presence; never selects/submits a disallowed file or verifies rejection/no artifact.
Loads history only; does not select two revisions or assert diff contents.
Loads protection form only; does not change protection or test editor/direct-edit denial.
Enters voucher name but does not configure quota, redeem/place order, or verify second-use rejection.
Creates carrier name only; does not set price range or test eligibility by cart total.
Creates admin order with quantity 1000 and expects error, opposite to successful payment/order and stock decrement.
Opens product/combinations form but does not create/adjust combination or verify storefront stock/AJAX.
Creates customer group only; does not set discount, assign customer, or verify effective catalog/cart price.
